metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for an agent that keeps its memory in VardeMem.

plugins.name: journal
plugins.description: Hooks that keep a VardeMem journal non-empty and well-formed, load the bounded read at session start, and remind when a journal line is owed.

plugins.name: memory-hygiene
plugins.description: A skill and a hook that keep Claude Code's auto-memory directory small: periodic consolidation with a snapshot undo, and a write-time routing check.
